rows.en: Ai: "........Right? Kasumi, you should say what you want
to say."
Kasumi: "Y-Yeah..."
Ai: "Oh, that look tells me you don't get it... Hm?"
Kasumi: "...Oh, Touya-chan."
Kasumi, was Ai picking on you?
Ai, what are you and Kasumi talking about?
Ai: "What's that supposed to mean?! How rude!"
Kasumi: "No, that's not it. Ai's worried about me..."
Touya: "Huh? Is that so?"
Ai: "How on earth did you decide I was giving Kasumi
a hard time?!"
Touya: "Well, I just got that impression..."
Ai: "Oh, I see. So that's all you think of me.
Hmph!"
Kasumi: "A-Ai..."
Touya: "Don't get so angry. I said I'm sorry."
Ai: "Oh! You don't sound sorry at all!"
Touya: "You're really laying into me... What's wrong?"
Yamato: "It's because you're taking Kasumi's side, Touya.
I believe this is what they call jealousy."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ai: "W-What?! W-What are you talking about?!
Of course it's nothing like that! W-Well,
I'll let it slide for today! S-See you!"
Yamato: "There she goes... Good grief."
Kasumi: "...Touya-chan."
Touya: "Hm?"
Kasumi: "Ai told me
I should express myself more clearly.
That I should say what I want to say..."
Touya: "Hmm. You might be a little too reserved.
But forcing yourself to change will only make you miserable.
Just take it slowly."
Kasumi: "Yeah... You're right.
Just like you said, Touya-chan, even if it's little by little,
I'll change. I'll do my best..."
Touya: "All right. But when people really need to,
they naturally learn to adapt
to the situation. Don't push yourself too hard. Take your time."
Kasumi: "Yeah... Thank you."
Yamato: "...By the way, whose words are those?
You didn't come up with that yourself, did you, Touya?"
Touya: "Oh, you caught me? Actually, my grandpa
used to say that a lot. He likes giving
those little lectures."
Kasumi: "Your grandfather, Touya-chan...
He ran a swordsmanship dojo, didn't he?"
Touya: "Yeah. I haven't seen him lately, but he should
be doing fine."
Yamato: "I knew it. I thought it was probably
something like that."
Touya: "What's wrong with that? It was all
I could think of."
Kasumi: "Whoever said it first, Touya-chan, you said it to me,
and that makes me happy. Thank you."
Touya: "O-Oh, sure."
Kasumi: "Well, I should get going."
Yamato: "Good luck, Kasumi."
Kasumi: "Okay. See you."
Ai: "Nothing much. I was just telling Kasumi she's too reserved,
that's all."
Touya: "Hmm."
Kasumi: "Do you think so too, Touya-chan?"
But I think that's part of who you are, Kasumi.
Yeah. You've got to speak up when you need to.
Ai: "It's because you're like that that we have a problem."
Touya: "But it's hard to change all at once, right?
She can do it little by little."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan..."
Ai: "So that's how it ends up. Hmph! I give up."
Touya: "What are you mad about?"
Ai: "I'm not mad!"
Touya: "You sure sound mad..."
Yamato: "It's because you're taking Kasumi's side, Touya.
I believe this is what they call jealousy."
Touya: "Huh?"
Ai: "W-What?! W-What are you talking about?!
Of course it's nothing like that! W-Well,
I'll let it slide for today! S-See you!"
Yamato: "There she goes... Good grief."
Kasumi: "...Touya-chan."
Touya: "Hm?"
Kasumi: "Ai told me
I should express myself more clearly.
That I should say what I want to say..."
Touya: "Hmm. You might be a little too reserved.
But forcing yourself to change will only make you miserable.
Just take it slowly."
Kasumi: "Yeah... You're right.
Just like you said, Touya-chan, even if it's little by little,
I'll change. I'll do my best..."
Touya: "All right. But when people really need to,
they naturally learn to adapt
to the situation. Don't push yourself too hard. Take your time."
Kasumi: "Yeah... Thank you."
Yamato: "...By the way, whose words are those?
You didn't come up with that yourself, did you, Touya?"
Touya: "Oh, you caught me? Actually, my grandpa
used to say that a lot. He likes giving
those little lectures."
Kasumi: "Your grandfather, Touya-chan...
He ran a swordsmanship dojo, didn't he?"
Touya: "Yeah. I haven't seen him lately, but he should
be doing fine."
Yamato: "I knew it. I thought it was probably
something like that."
Touya: "What's wrong with that? It was all
I could think of."
Kasumi: "Whoever said it first, Touya-chan, you said it to me,
and that makes me happy. Thank you."
Touya: "O-Oh, sure."
Kasumi: "Well, I should get going."
Yamato: "Good luck, Kasumi."
Kasumi: "Okay. See you."
Ai: "See? Everyone thinks so."
Kasumi: "But..."
Touya: "You just need a little more courage.
Otherwise, you won't even be able to ask for help
when you're in danger in battle."
Kasumi: "Y-Yeah... That's true, but..."
Ai: "See? Kasumi, it's not like you don't have opinions.
You should say what you think."
Kasumi: "Y-Yeah..."
Touya: "You don't have to force yourself to change.
But Ai, me, and everyone else are your friends.
Holding back will only make things harder for you."
Kasumi: "R-Really...?"
Ai: "Exactly. Touya's saying it too,
so that's what you should do."
Touya: "...I don't think it matters whether I said it or not..."
Ai: 'It's fine! This way works better.'
Touya: 'Huh?'
Ai: 'I said...'
Kasumi: "...I'll... try a little."
Ai: "Huh?"
Kasumi: "I know I can't just stay the way I am.
Ai: "A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Just start with a little at a time."
Kasumi: "Yeah, thank you."
Touya: "Well, you had a point this time."
Ai: "Ahem! Hm? I don't like the way you put that."
Touya: "...You're imagining it."
Ai: "Oh, well. Now that that's settled, it's time for special training!"
Kasumi: "Huh...? S-Special training...?"
Ai: "That's right! Come on, let's go!"
Kasumi: "Huh? Huh?! What?!"
Yamato: "...Will she be all right?"
Touya: "Well, Kasumi speaks up when she really doesn't want something,
so she should be fine. Putting other people's feelings first
is both her good point and her problem."
Yamato: "Oh..."
Touya: "W-What?"
Yamato: "You seem oblivious, but you really do pay attention."
Touya: "You know..."
Yamato: "Hahaha. Well, then there's nothing to worry about.
Let's get going too."
Touya: "Yeah..."
